info.title: AgentReady Lab API
info.description: Adversarial crash-testing, dual-ledger reconciliation, and self-healing for agentic commerce stores.

get.description: Returns service vitality and configuration status. Prevents cold starts on Render.

get.summary: Stream live run telemetry frames via SSE
get.description: Streams real-time agent_step, paypal_event, store_ledger_row, finding, and run_completed events.
Returns pre-registered demo targets (Naive Shop, Hardened Shop) and user-registered stores.

post.description: Registers an external or custom target sandbox store.

get.description: Returns metadata for the 9 adversarial AI buyer personas in the test pack.

post.description: Triggers a crash test run with the specified target, pack, seed, and optional callback URL.

get.description: Retrieves the current status, Agent-Readiness Score, and summary breakdown.

get.summary: List findings with PayPal evidence IDs
get.description: Returns all invariant rule violations detected by the Reconciler.
Returns normalized side-by-side rows comparing PayPal Sandbox records vs Store Probe rows.
Returns Markdown or JSON audit report for merchant export.

200.description: JSON audit report or plain Markdown text

get.summary: Export Postman collection for run findings
get.description: Generates a downloadable Postman Collection v2.1.0 with reproduction requests for failed findings.

post.description: Re-runs the exact same seed against the target store or an alternative patched target.

get.description: Generates an SVG score badge for README or merchant site.
Returns the 12-bug detection matrix with true positive and false alarm verification data.

post.description: Live webhook endpoint registered in PayPal Developer Dashboard. Validates HMAC/RSA signature and dispatches events to dual-ledger.

200.description: Webhook received, verified, and queued for reconciliation

401.description: Signature verification failed — forged or tampered webhook rejected

get.summary: Get recommended Judge Arena shopping prompts & chaos presets
get.description: Returns curated presets for quick 1-click judging demonstrations.

post.summary: Execute an interactive Judge Arena shopping mission
post.description: Runs a single AI shopper prompt through Channel3, Chaos Proxy, and PayPal Sandbox with real-time telemetry.

get.summary: Stream Judge Arena telemetry events via SSE into AG Grid
